text:
alex: Quick heads up — noticed vault-proxy 403 spike after yesterday's RBAC tighten. A couple of partner ingest pipelines started failing. timeline + short plan?

maria: saw the same, charts show a sharp jump at 10:23 UTC. likely a missing role on the new iam-binding. impact appears limited to svc-redwood-ingest and svc-redwood-analytics.

jess: can you paste a sample log line? I want to confirm it's the proxy rejecting vs KMS.

alex: sure, here's a snippet from the proxy logs:

```
2026-03-22T10:23:12.412Z vault-proxy ERROR request_id=abc123 status=403 user=svc-redwood-ingest@redwood project=redwood-prod action=decrypt reason="permission denied: kms.keyDecrypt"
2026-03-22T10:23:12.418Z vault-proxy WARN  lease=0 user=svc-redwood-ingest token_id=tok-xxxxx
```

maria: that matches — proxy couldn't call KMS decrypt, so vault returned 403 upstream. KMS IAM role change likely. I checked audit logs -> most denies are from service-account: svc-redwood-ingest@redwood.

ryan: I rolled a policy change last night to tighten decrypt on the staging KMS key and meant to mirror it to prod later. looks like prod got a partial binding by mistake. my bad.

sam: ok actionable: we should (1) temporarily re-add decrypt binding for svc-redwood-ingest, (2) revoke any long-lived tokens that might have been impacted, (3) schedule a planned rotation for the KMS key and update docs, (4) add a guard in CI to prevent partial-policy pushes.

jess: I can re-add the binding now if cmd ready. maria/rayn can confirm the exact role and resource path.

maria: role needed: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter on resource projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/main/cryptoKeys/ingest-key. command (gcloud):

```
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod \
  --member=serviceAccount:svc-redwood-ingest@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter \
  --condition=None
```

jess: doing it now. will watch proxy metrics and error rate.

jess: done — added role at 10:28 UTC. rolling back to you for verification. :white_check_mark:

maria: proxy 403s dropped within 30s, pipelines started green again. good rollback. we still need to rotate the key and perform a scoped rotation of any wrapped tokens.

alex: agreed. two follow-ups: (A) quick rotation plan for the ingest-key with minimal downtime, (B) audit improvements so future partial-policy pushes are flagged.

ryan: for rotation plan i propose: create a new primary key version, update vault-transit config to target new key version (can use key alias), then do a phased rewrap:
- create new key version (gcloud kms keys versions create ...)
- update vault's KMS config to point to new version alias
- rewrap in batches (ingest -> analytics) using a small batch script that monitors errors
- keep old version for 7 days before destroy

sam: add to that: create a preflight check that runs vault-client decrypt test for each service identity before we switch traffic. snippet:

```
# validate decrypt works
vault write -format=json transit/decrypt-ingest ciphertext=$(cat test-cipher.txt)
```

maria: on audit improvements: suggestion to add an enforcement check in our infra CI that prevents partial IAM diffs for KMS resources. If a policy touches a KMS key it must include a full set of required principals or fail. I can draft a Conftest/Gate rule.

ryan: i'll pair with you on the test. also will add an operator check in the terraform module to require explicit allowlist.

jess: we should also redact sensitive fields in the proxy logs that are forwarded to splunk. propose adding a "privmask" transform so we don't leak project ids/keys in plain text.

vault-bot: notice: vault-audit-forwarder detected 12 log entries containing resource:projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/main. Potential sensitive exposure. Recommend redaction.

maria: thanks vault-bot. jess can you open a small PR to add the masking transform and we can ship to staging?

jess: will do. target roll to staging today, prod tomorrow if green.

alex: ok owners: jess (masking + emergency binding rollback), ryan+maria (rotation play + CI gate), sam (revoke long-lived tokens + rewrap script). please update the incident tracker and tag me for final signoff.

oncall-bot: incident created: INC-2026-1349 — "kms-decrypt-403-after-policy-change" assigned to oncall. Estimated impact: low-medium.

sam: one more note — we should coordinate with partners who use the ingest pipeline (partner-ops@) before we rotate keys. i'll draft a short advisory with a fallback window.

alex: perfect. timeline: rollback done, mask PR, rotation plan + CI gate draft by EOD, partner advisory in 2 hours. thanks everyone. :bow:
